triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/archetype.py around line 621, add `{wilson_lower_bound_sql()} AS quality_score` to the SELECT list (import wilson_lower_bound_sql from clauses). The API camelizes field names automatically so it will appear as qualityScore in the JSON response. In shared_web/static/js/metagamegrid.jsx, add a div with title='Quality Score' inside renderItem showing archetype.qualityScore, either as a tooltip on an existing stat or as a new row — even a hidden data-quality attribute satisfies the 'even just in a comment' request in the issue.
triage.notes: No schema migration needed; quality_score is a computed column from existing wins/losses data. Change touches one SQL query and one JSX component.
